about: Where the build departs from the scroll map, and why (map/BUILDING.md). moves: positions (metres, X east, D north), applied by tools/map_layout.mjs on top of map/world/S5.json when it writes layout.json. how: an entity built differently from its kind's default (tools/loyalty_check.mjs). unbuilt: mapped entities not built yet, with the reason and who decided. edges: how the walkable area is closed and what is shown beyond it. Sizes chosen by the builder are marked 'choice:' in blender/gate_scene.py. Keep every list short, and drop an entry when the map or the build makes it unnecessary.

S5.tree.elm_6580.why: its base is estimated at the silk's bottom edge, and the lower flight's foot (a builder choice below the silk) runs through it; it stands just west of the flight, which the painting hides behind these trees

S5.tree.willow_shoots_6600.why: as elm_6580: base estimated at the silk's edge, on the line of the lower flight; it stands just east of the flight

S5.grd.rock_mound_7200.why: a mound of earth and rock with trees on it (the scroll paints it as a solid thing, not as the ground surface); built as kit earth_mound with rocks

sides.what: invisible walls round the painted area, one per side (edge:south, edge:east, edge:north, edge:west; the world page drops a side that is a seam with a loaded neighbour): layout painted_area (the section's seams at u 5600 and 9400 and the silk's top edge, on the ground), its south edge carried down to 1.5 m past the lower flight's foot
sides.why: outside the painted area the scroll paints nothing for this section; the south edge is moved so the flight (whose foot is below the silk's edge, a builder choice) can be climbed
sides.beyond: painting, not models: mist (the scroll's blank silk) past the silk's bottom and top edges; the neighbouring sections (S4 east, S6 west) as paintings until they are built (web/src/backdrop.js)

moat.what: invisible walls along both moat banks beside the bridge and across the channel's north end
moat.why: keeps walkers out of the water; nothing is painted there to stand on
